title: Staff and roles
subtitle: Invite people, choose what each person can do, and limit teachers to their classes.

loadError.title: We couldn't load your staff
loadError.body: Check your internet connection and try again.

empty.title: No staff yet
empty.body: Invite your first teacher, cashier or administrator.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation for {name}?
revoke.body: The link stops working. You can invite them again later.

disable.title: Disable {name}?
disable.body: They are signed out at once and cannot log in until you enable them again.

enable.title: Enable {name}?
enable.body: They can log in again with their existing password.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.body: They get a link by text or email, valid for 72 hours, to set up their login.

roleHint.owner: Everything, including staff, roles and settings.
roleHint.admin: Day-to-day running: students, classes and imports. No staff or settings.
roleHint.teacher: Sees the students and classes they are assigned to.
roleHint.cashier: Reads students and classes. Fee collection arrives in a later release.
roleHint.gatekeeper: Reads the student list at the door.

invite.phoneHint: This role confirms new devices with an SMS code, so a phone number is needed.

errors.name: Enter the person's name.
errors.phone: Enter a Sri Lankan mobile number, for example 077 123 4567.
errors.phoneRequired: A phone number is needed for this role.
errors.taken: Someone at your institute already uses this phone number or email, or has been invited.

edit.title: Change role for {name}
edit.body: Saving sets this role and replaces any other role they had.

scope.hint: Tick none to show only the classes they teach.

errors.forbidden: Only owners can change staff, or you've been signed out.
errors.conflict: That can't be done: the institute must keep at least one active owner, or this person's details are already used.
errors.planLimit: Your plan has no free seat for this role. Upgrade your plan or free a seat first.
errors.validation: Some details aren't valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find that person. They may have been removed.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
